chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Ubayd Allah informed me, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Yahya, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ali ibn Isma'il, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Aba Abdillah عليه السلام about a man who becomes junub during travel and finds nothing during the journey except snow. He said: He performs ghusl with snow or with river water.

key_terms.الثَّلْجَ: snow used here as the available means for purification
key_terms.السَّفَرِ: travel or journeying away from home
key_terms.مَاءِ النَّهَرِ: river water as a source for ritual purification
key_terms.يَغْتَسِلُ: he performs ghusl, the ritual bath
key_terms.يُجْنِبُ: enters the state of janabah requiring ghusl

ai.seo_question: What should a traveler do for ghusl if he becomes junub and only finds snow?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning taharah for a traveler who enters a state requiring ghusl and does not find ordinary accessible water except snow. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام instructs that ghusl may be performed with snow or with river water, showing practical guidance in conditions of hardship during travel.
